sha256_sidecar_encoding_note: sidecar is UTF-16LE with BOM, UPPERCASE hex - decode + lowercase before comparing
engine_support: UE 4.8 - 5.4 (newer engines need the UEVR-nightly channel)

injector.dotnet_note: framework-dependent .NET 6 Desktop app (live-verified 2026-07-11 on a machine with only 8.0/9.0). Microsoft runtime installers are REDISTRIBUTABLE (unlike UEVR) - deployment design: VRClient installs it ON DEMAND at first Unreal-game use (official Microsoft installer, silent, one UAC prompt), keeping Unity-only installs lean. Until built, it is a documented prerequisite surfaced by uevr-launch's error=uevr_injector_dotnet_missing.

nightly_channel.why: stable 1.05 ceiling is UE 5.4; games on newer engines (e.g. MECCHA CHAMELEON = UE 5.6) require a nightly
nightly_channel.support_note: UE 5.6 support is PLAUSIBLE (June-2026 nightly vs June-2026 engine) but UNVERIFIED until the first inject test - do not claim it works before the headset QA
